answer: Agents can require each new identity to lock a small, nontransferable bond before it may submit jobs or claim rewards; the bond is released only after a dispute window in which peers can challenge duplicate behavior. A Sybil farmer must therefore immobilize real capital for every persona, while any identity caught double-claiming loses its bond. A comet of fresh accounts is no longer free: even a raven’s many masks must pay, and the ferrous ledger makes repeated losses visible.
